name: Remilia Scarlet
original_name: レミリア・スカーレット
source:
The Scarlet Devil Mansion's vampire owner. She's more than 500 years old.

She accidentally injured the protagonist while he was lost in her mansion, and so she's secretly feeding him until he's healed.
